Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Yojana (12th Pass)

The scheme “Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Yojana (12th Pass)” launched by the Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support meritorious girl students by providing scooters or ₹40,000 to eligible girl students
The applicant must be studying in any school or college located in Rajasthan.
